chunks.text: Ugh, today’s been a mess. I’m in Beijing and I’m kinda debating whether I should just rent a car for a few days instead of dealing with rides everywhere.
Also, that ride I booked earlier isn’t happening anymore — the one labeled RIDE789012. And if I do drive, I haven’t even thought about where I’d park around town.
If it comes down to it, the car I keep coming back to is the Volkswagen Lavida, and I’d start it on 2026-04-18.
Yeah, let’s just lock it in — book it for 5 days under Huang Tao.
